newsitem.title: INDIA: United Front's Laloo says there will be elections.
newsitem.headline: United Front's Laloo says there will be elections.

text.p: Senior United Front leader Laloo Prasad Yadav said on Thursday that India will have to hold fresh general elections as talks with the Congress party had failed.
"Read my lips. There will be elections. Let the people decide," Laloo told reporters in New Delhi.

"No. I have told them (Congress negotiators) no more talks," Laloo said, when asked whether there will be a another round of talks between the United Front and Congress after the adjournment of second round talks earlier on Thursday.
The Congress had given two main proposals in the talks, he said.
The Congress wanted to form a government and asked United Front for support, he added. The second proposal was change in leadership, Laloo said.
"Even after April 11, United Front will not break," he said, adding that the United Front ruled out any change in its leadership.
